mapper.select: SELECT m.magazine_no, m.magazine_title, m.magazine_content, m.magazine_reg_date, m.magazine_view_cnt, f.file_no, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_system_name FROM magazine m LEFT JOIN files f ON m.magazine_no = f.magazine_no WHERE m.magazine_no = #{no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO magazine (magazine_title, magazine_content, user_no) VALUES (#{magazineTitle}, #{magazineContent}, #{userNo})
INSERT INTO files(file_no, file_name, file_path, file_system_name, magazine_no) VALUES (#{fileNo}, #{oriName}, #{path}, #{systemName}, #{magazineNo});
